title: 第21章 缉凶求追读求收藏求月票推荐票第22章 南城司马求追读求收藏求月票推荐票
content_zh:
武陵。
南城。
朦胧的月光下，一道人影仿佛轻烟一般飘进一间院子。
那院子收拾得干干净净，显然主人是个勤快之人。
那人影落在院子里，轻巧地如同一只猫似的，没有发出丝毫声音。
那是一个约莫二三十岁的青年，身上穿着一看就价值不菲的丝绸绫罗，头发上还插着一支桃花。
他咧开嘴，无声的笑着，青白的脸色在月光下显得有些渗人。
下一刻，他手中出现了一根半尺来长的竹管。
他身形一晃，无声地来到窗前，轻轻用竹管捅破了窗户纸，然后把嘴对上去吹了口气。
霎时间，一缕粉红色的雾气从竹管中喷出，以极快的速度在房间里蔓延开来。
房间里，一个少女拥着被褥睡在床上，那粉红色的雾气钻进她的口鼻之中。
她的呼吸，渐渐变得深沉起来，身体也渐渐放软，双手垂了下来，大片的肌肤裸露了出来。
窗外，青年看到这一幕，不自禁地舔了舔舌头。
“普通人家有这等姿色也是少见，如此年轻的身体，怎能虚度良宵呢？”
青年喃喃自语道，“就让我来好好地疼爱疼爱你。”
砰！
一声轻响，青年一掌震断门栓，然后毫无顾忌地推开了房门。
中了他的迷烟，就算是再大的动静也是醒不过来的，随便自己怎么折腾，她也只会配合。
一想到少女年轻的躯体，他心中就躁动了起来，连身体都有了反应。
然而。

他一只脚刚刚跨进房间，忽然心中警兆顿生。
他身形像是装了弹簧一般，嗖地一下就弹了出去，身体像是没有重量一般瞬间退后了数尺。
就在这个时候，他刚刚站立的地方，一支羽箭插在那里，入地三寸，箭尾还在微微颤抖。
杜迁瞳孔猛然收缩。
“谁？！”
他低声喝道。
周围一片寂静，只有呼呼的风声吹过。
杜迁浑身紧绷，一脸警惕地观察着周围。
铮！
一声轻响，一支羽箭从黑暗之中袭来。
“找到你了！”
杜迁心中冷哼一声，身形一晃，避过那支羽箭，下一刻，他就要向着羽箭袭来的方向扑去。
这个暗箭伤人，打扰了自己雅兴的家伙，自己一定会让他知道，得罪了他杜迁的下场是什么！
他动作刚起，忽然又是一支羽箭从另外一个方向袭来。
如果他继续向前，那正好是自己主动往羽箭上面撞去。
杜迁猛地停下脚步，已经是惊出了一身冷汗。
不止一个人！
content_en:
Wuling.
Nancheng.
Under the hazy moonlight, a figure floated into a courtyard like light smoke.
The yard was neatly kept, and the owner was obviously a diligent man.
The figure landed in the yard, as light as a cat, without making the slightest sound.
He was a young man of about 20 or 30 years old. He was wearing a silk damask that looked very valuable at first glance, and he had a peach blossom in his hair.
He grinned and smiled silently, his pale face looking a little oozing in the moonlight.
The next moment, a half-foot-long bamboo pipe appeared in his hand.
He swayed, silently came to the window, gently pierced the window paper with a bamboo pipe, and then put his mouth to it and blew a breath.
In an instant, a wisp of pink mist sprayed out from the bamboo tube and spread throughout the room at an extremely fast speed.
In the room, a girl was sleeping on the bed, hugging the quilt, and the pink mist got into her mouth and nose.
Her breathing gradually became deeper, her body gradually relaxed, her hands dropped, and a large area of ​​skin was exposed.
Outside the window, the young man saw this scene and couldn't help but lick his tongue.
"It is rare for ordinary people to have such beauty. How can such a young body waste a good night?"
The young man murmured to himself, "Just let me love and love you properly."
Bang!
With a soft sound, the young man broke the door bolt with his palm, and then pushed the door open without any scruples.
After falling under his spell, she would not be able to wake up no matter how loud the noise was. No matter how hard she tried, she would only cooperate.
When he thought of the girl's young body, his heart became restless, and even his body reacted.
However.
As soon as he stepped into the room with one foot, a warning sign suddenly occurred in his heart.
His figure seemed to be loaded with springs, and he jumped out with a swish, and his body instantly retreated several feet as if it was weightless.
At this moment, where he had just stood, an arrow was inserted there, three inches into the ground, and the tail of the arrow was still trembling slightly.
Du Qian's pupils suddenly shrank.
"Who?!"
he shouted in a low voice.
There was silence all around, except for the whistling wind.
Du Qian's whole body tensed up and he observed his surroundings with vigilance.
Zheng!
There was a soft sound, and an arrow struck from the darkness.
"Found you!"
Du Qian snorted in his heart and swayed to avoid the feather arrow. The next moment, he was about to pounce in the direction of the arrow.
This guy who stabbed people in the back and disturbed his elegance, I will definitely let him know what the consequences of Du Qian will be if he offends him!
As soon as he started to move, another feather arrow suddenly struck from another direction.
If he continues to move forward, he will hit the feather arrow on his own initiative.
Du Qian stopped suddenly and broke into a cold sweat.
More than one person!
